application_type_full: Tree works: Trees in conservation areas/subject to TPOs
description:
Rear Garden
	
T1	Purple Leafed Plum (Prunus cerasifera 'Pissardii')	30% Crown Reduction - Reducing the height and spread of the tree by approximately 2-3m to tidy and contain. Final height = 4m and final spread = 3m.

T2	Purple Leafed Plum (Prunus cerasifera 'Pissardii')	30% Crown Reduction - Reducing the height and spread of the tree by approximately 2-3m to tidy and contain. Final height = 4m and final spread = 3m.
	
T3	Rowan (Sorbus aucuparia)	Carry out Formative Pruning - Removing weak, damaged, crossing or dead branches to keep the tree in good form for the future.Final height and spread = unchanged.	

T5	Judas tree (Cercis siliquastrum)	Reduce/Thin out dense section over clients garden as it is becoming quite heavy and overextended. Reduce section growing over neighbours garden to limit overhang, leaving an overall more balanced tree. Final height = unchanged and final spread = 8m.	

T6	Fig tree (Ficus carica)	Cut back from conservatory to give approximately 0.5-1m clearance. Final height and spread = unchanged.
